body: For example, let's assume a replica is attempting to catch up by sending `GetState` message. It will now wait to receive a `NewState` message, but there are many reasons why that may not happen. Maybe the replica we sent the `GetState` message to died or the message got lost. Therefore, resend (some) messages after some timeout period to make progress in the presence of failures.

comments.body: Done. Replicas re-send unanswered protocol messages from their idle periods since 9a74a74: a backup waiting for NewState re-sends GetState, the primary re-sends the Prepare for every uncommitted op, and backups acknowledge re-sent Prepares again. Clients re-send a request that got no reply, to every replica, since bbcc14d. View change messages are re-sent the same way since 06ba5de, and Recovery since f8acf51. The simulator found the original stall: seed 7008082073273156606 at c149be7 lost one GetState and never recovered.

title: Resend messages after timeout
